title: Only Minuteman launched from a silo, at November 2
place_text: November 2 launch facility, Ellsworth missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: the only missile that ever flew out of the ground in the minute man program was at November 2 where I was located not during my time but in the 60s and I believe it flew for 5 seconds

plain: Mario Woods, a former nuclear missile guard in South Dakota, says the site where he was posted, a launch facility called November 2, has a special history. According to Woods, it was the only place a Minuteman, the US land-based nuclear missile, ever actually flew out of its underground silo, back in the 1960s, before his time. He believes it flew for about five seconds.
